instruction: Save the current video frame as 'screenshot.png' on your Desktop.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Variation 2: Generic filename 'screenshot.png'. Simpler instruction phrasing.
metadata.verification: Task requires taking a VLC screenshot and saving to screenshot.png. Evaluator checks if file exists at /home/user/Desktop/screenshot.png.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts all necessary file properties: existence, MIME type validation, file size, and modification time
Metric properly validates all requirements: file exists, is valid PNG, has reasonable size (>1KB), and was created recently (within 5 minutes)
Expected parameter handling is correct: metric uses 'expected.get("exists")' which correctly accesses the rules dict returned by get_rule()
Temporal validation prevents false positives from pre-existing files: is_recent check ensures file was created/modified within task execution timeframe
File type validation prevents false positives from non-image files: MIME type check ensures it's actually a PNG image
Size validation excludes dummy/empty files: 1KB minimum threshold filters out trivial files
Evaluator can semantically distinguish between legitimate VLC screenshot and various false positive scenarios (pre-existing file, wrong type, dummy file)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider increasing minimum file size threshold from 1KB to 5-10KB for stronger validation, as real screenshots are typically much larger
Minor: The 5-minute recency window is reasonable but could be made configurable if needed for slower systems
